summary: First full test run on BYD BIPO Showroom (both backend + frontend). Public APIs, super-admin auth, admin CRUD, homepage/settings updates, analytics, activity logs, financing, tracking, sitemap, and public UI all work. Two CRITICAL bugs found: (1) all 3 seeded staff accounts cannot log in because their emails use the reserved `.test` TLD which pydantic EmailStr rejects (422), blocking RBAC entirely; (2) brute-force lockout is effectively bypassed because the login identifier uses `request.client.host` which resolves to the ingress pod IP and is round-robined across pods, so attempts never accumulate to MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 on a single identifier. 31 backend tests passed, 1 test failed (brute-force), 10 tests errored (all blocked by staff-login bug).

critical.issue: Seeded staff accounts (content@bydbipo.test, sales@bydbipo.test, analytics@bydbipo.test) return 422 'value is not a valid email address: The part after the @-sign is a special-use or reserved name that cannot be used with email.' Pydantic's email-validator library rejects .test TLD. Effect: content_admin, sales_admin, analytics_admin roles cannot log in at all -- RBAC path completely untestable via the API. Fix: change seed staff emails to a valid TLD (e.g., @bydbipo.example.com or @bipoauto.com) AND update /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Alternatively, relax LoginInput.email from EmailStr to plain str with a light regex.

5+ consecutive failed logins for the same email do NOT return 429. Root cause: `_check_lockout` uses identifier = f"{request.client.host}:{email}". Behind the k8s ingress, request.client.host is the immediate proxy/pod IP and is round-robined across multiple pods (observed 10.219.3.101 and 10.219.3.90 in db.login_attempts). Attempts split across identifiers, none reaches count=5 within the same identifier. This effectively disables brute-force protection. Fix: use email alone as identifier, or trust X-Forwarded-For (first hop) as client IP.

minor.issue: Dead code: the `if last and (now_utc() - last.replace(...) if hasattr(last,'replace') else None): pass` block is a no-op; remove.
`whatsapp_clicks + await count(...)` inside funnel dict literal works but readability is poor; consider computing once.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: `<span>` rendered as child of native `<option>` in /app/frontend/src/admin/Dashboard.jsx line ~72-73 (period selector). Invalid HTML; option children must be plain text. Cause looks like an editor wrapper (`data-ve-dynamic` span). Not blocking but console-noisy.

Multiple recharts warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Chart ResponsiveContainer parents likely have no explicit height on initial paint. Charts still render eventually but log many warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: Login rate limiter identifier is IP-based but IP is unreliable behind ingress -> lockout ineffective. Move to email-based rate limit or use X-Forwarded-For with trusted proxy config.
EmailStr in LoginInput and UserInput rejects .test/.example/.invalid reserved TLDs -- seed data must avoid these TLDs or validation must be loosened for internal accounts.
seed.py does not appear to update existing staff accounts if seed data drifts (couldn't verify -- file not opened). Recommend idempotent upserts and re-hashing password when it changes.
core.get_current_user calls ObjectId(payload['sub']) directly instead of oid() helper -- would 500 on malformed sub instead of 401. Wrap in try/except InvalidId -> 401.

admin_router.update_item allows arbitrary fields via `payload: dict` -- no schema/whitelist. Any field can be overwritten including `views`, `source`, `created_at` filter check exists but easy to bypass with `_id` (excluded) but not e.g. `password_hash` on user collections if reused. Consider per-resource Pydantic models.
activity_logs stores previous_value=ser(existing) which may contain very large nested docs for vehicles -- can bloat DB over time; consider storing diff or key fields only.
public_router.compare returns docs but does not error if fewer than requested slugs match (silently drops missing) -- consider returning per-slug status.

rca_of_the_issue.staff_login_422: pydantic email-validator rejects reserved TLDs per RFC 2606 (.test, .example, .invalid, .localhost). Seed inserts users directly via db.users.insert_one bypassing validation, but LoginInput uses EmailStr which enforces validation on the way in.
rca_of_the_issue.brute_force_bypass: identifier composed of `{request.client.host}:{email}`. Behind k8s ingress with multiple backend pods, client.host is the peer IP of whichever pod receives the request. Observed pods 10.219.3.90 and 10.219.3.101; 7 sequential curl requests split across pods, so no single identifier ever accumulated >=5 failures. login_attempts collection confirms: two rows with count=5 vs count=2 for the same email but different pod IPs. Reproduce: `for i in {1..7}; do curl -X POST .../api/auth/login -d '{"email":"a@b.com","password":"x"}'; done` -- expect eventual 429, actually always 401. Mitigation: use email alone as identifier.
